Name: Wild Truffles
Author: tigerchatoyance
Description:
What it says on the tin, this mod spawns truffles in the Secret Woods.

The mod has now been updated to [CP] to allow for a config that will be generated for you upon start-up that lets the user adjust the truffle spawn amount on the fly, to a maximum of 55 per day! A truffle lasts for 7 in game days before it despawns, so be aware of that so you don't overwhelm your poor woods! :) Thank you so much to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BurritoBlankie]BurritoBlankie[/url] for putting in all that time and effort to convert the mod to Content Patcher! The new file contains both [CP] and [FTM] folders and you need both for the mod to function.

It *should* work with mods that change the layout of the Secret Woods, though I only tested with vanilla, Stardew Valley Maps Retouched, and
Stardew Valley Expanded (the western woods included). Just plunk the main file into your Mods folder and you should be good to go.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]





[b][FOR THE PREVIOUS 1.0.0 [FTM] VERSION ONLY][/b]
By default, the mod will spawn at most 1 truffle per day (but sometimes none). If you want to change this, edit the value next to "MaximumSpawnsPerDay" in the content.json. You can change the MinimumSpawnsPerDay this way too.
